intro: A school or colony in Sambhal that orders playground equipment from us usually wants to know one thing first: how does it reach a town this size, and who puts it up? FunPlay Systems builds every piece at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,170 km away. It travels by road to your site, and our installation team or a dealer in north India fixes it in place.

Sambhal sits in the western Uttar Pradesh plains, between Moradabad and Badaun, and is known for its horn and bone handicrafts. Summers here are very hot and winters bring fog and cold mornings, so we suggest galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic for most sites. Send us the size of your ground, the age of the children and a few photos. We will reply with suggested equipment and a layout drawing that marks the safe play area.

sections.h: What to arrange before installation day in Sambhal
sections.html:
A little preparation on your side saves a lot of time once the truck arrives. Clear and level the area marked on our layout drawing, and remove stones, roots and building waste. Keep a covered, lockable room near the site where the packed equipment can be stored for a day or two.

For grouted pieces, the team will need cement, sand, aggregate and water close at hand, so confirm with us who arranges these. Make sure the delivery vehicle can reach the gate. If you also plan a fitness corner for adults, see our outdoor gym equipment in Sambhal, or our page for nearby Moradabad.

faq.q: Do you install playground equipment in a smaller town like Sambhal?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road anywhere in India. Installation in Sambhal is done by our own team or by a dealer in north India who works with us.

faq.q: What materials do we need to keep ready for grouting?
faq.a: Usually cement, sand, aggregate and water near the site. We confirm the exact list and who supplies it when we share the layout drawing and quote.

faq.q: How long is the warranty on swings and slides?
faq.a: The warranty is three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when our installation and maintenance instructions are followed.

intro: Sangli, Miraj and Kupwad come under one municipal corporation, so a single civic order can cover gardens in three towns at once. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for these public gardens, and for schools and housing societies across the area. Our factory in Vasai East is about 330 km away, which keeps road delivery within Maharashtra simple.

Sangli is known for its turmeric market and sugar factories, and Miraj for its hospitals and its sitar makers. Public gardens here are used by families from early morning walkers to children in the evening, so the equipment takes heavy, unsupervised use. Share the size of each garden and a few photos with us. We will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing for each site, with the safe play area clearly marked.

sections.h: Equipment for public gardens in Sangli, Miraj and Kupwad
sections.html:
In a public garden nobody checks how the equipment is used, so pick pieces with few loose parts. Fixed climbers, slides and a merry-go-round handle rough play better than delicate items. Grout every post into concrete so nothing can be shifted or lifted.

Place benches outside the safe play area so parents can watch without sitting in a swing path. Ask the garden staff to walk round the equipment each morning and report loose bolts early. The Sangli plains get less rain than the coast, but summers are hot, so keep slides out of the afternoon sun. For a Maharashtra project, see our work at Raymond, Thane, or our page for Kolhapur.

faq.q: Can one quote cover gardens in Sangli, Miraj and Kupwad?
faq.a: Yes. Send us the size and photos of each garden. We prepare a separate layout drawing for each site and one combined quote that your office can review.

faq.q: Which equipment lasts longest in a busy public garden?
faq.a: Grouted pieces with few moving parts, such as slides, climbers and merry-go-rounds, built in galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic. Regular checks by the garden staff help them last longer.

faq.q: Do you deliver from Vasai to Sangli by road?
faq.a: Yes. The equipment travels by road from our Vasai factory, about 330 km away, and our installation team or a local dealer installs it on site.

intro: Sasaram, home to the tomb of Sher Shah Suri, is a district town in the hot plains of south-western Bihar. Schools are the main buyers of playground equipment here, from small private schools to larger campuses that want a proper play area. FunPlay Systems makes this equipment at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,300 km away, and sends it by road.

Most school managements in Sasaram start by asking what a playground will cost. The honest answer is that it depends on a few choices you control, which we explain below. Send us the size of your ground, the classes that will use it and some photos. We reply with suggested equipment, a layout drawing with the safe play area marked and a quote you can compare.

sections.h: What decides the cost of a school playground
sections.html:
Four things move the budget most. First is the number and size of the pieces, since one large structure costs more than a swing and a slide. Next comes the surface, because rubber flooring adds cost but cushions falls and stays usable after rain. Third is the footing: grouted posts need concrete work, while some pieces can stand on a firm base. Last is site preparation, such as levelling and drainage, which your contractor may handle.

A sensible plan is a few individual pieces now and a larger structure later. Summers in Sasaram are fierce, so leave budget for shade. See our page for nearby Gaya.

faq.q: Can you suggest equipment within a fixed school budget?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us your budget along with the ground size and age group. We will suggest pieces that fit both and show them on a layout drawing before you decide.

faq.q: Is rubber flooring needed for a school in Sasaram?
faq.a: We recommend an impact-absorbing surface under swings, slides and climbers. Rubber flooring cushions falls and dries faster than soil after the monsoon, which matters on a busy school ground.

faq.q: Do you also supply outdoor gym equipment in Sasaram?
faq.a: Yes. Our Fun Fitness range suits staff, older students and parks. You can add a few machines at the edge of the same ground and include them in one layout.

intro: Satara district runs from the dry plains around the city up to Mahabaleshwar and Panchgani, and Panchgani has long been known for its boarding schools. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to residential schools, day schools, housing societies and gardens across the district. Our factory in Vasai East is about 220 km away, and we deliver by road.

A boarding school uses its play area very differently from a day school. Children are on campus in the evenings and at weekends, so the equipment gets far more hours of use. Tell us how many students live on campus, their age range and the size of the ground. We will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, so the school can plan play areas near the hostels as well as the classrooms.

sections.h: Planning play areas on a residential school campus
sections.html:
Spread the play areas out. A small set of swings and a see-saw near each hostel gives younger boarders somewhere to play after study hours. A larger multi play station near the main ground suits group play at weekends.

Up on the plateau the monsoon is very heavy, and mist and damp last for months. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle this well, and rubber flooring on a drained base keeps the area usable between showers. Down in Satara city the rain is lighter and summers are warmer, so shade matters more. For a Maharashtra project, see Raymond, Thane.

faq.q: Can you supply schools in Panchgani and Mahabaleshwar as well as Satara city?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road across Satara district, including the hill towns. Our installation team or a local dealer installs the equipment on site.

faq.q: How do we keep equipment in good shape through a long, wet monsoon?
faq.a: Use galvanised steel and roto-moulded parts, lay the play area on a drained base and wipe down slides and seats after heavy rain. Check bolts and footings once the monsoon ends.

faq.q: What age groups do you design for?
faq.a: We have equipment for toddlers right up to older primary children. Tell us the age range on your campus and we will suggest pieces for each group.

intro: Cement plants ring Satna, in the Vindhya region of Madhya Pradesh, and several of these companies fund schools, anganwadis and village facilities under their CSR budgets. A playground is a common CSR project because the benefit is easy to see. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for such projects at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,000 km away.

We also supply schools, colonies and gardens in Satna city. For a CSR project, the CSR team usually needs a clear proposal before it can approve spending. Send us the site size, photos and the number and age of the children. We will return suggested equipment, a layout drawing with the safe play area marked and a quote that can go straight into your proposal file.

sections.h: Putting together a CSR playground proposal in Satna
sections.html:
A strong proposal covers the site, the children and the upkeep. Give the location and size of the ground, with photos, and the number of children who will use it. Attach our layout drawing and quote, along with the warranty terms. State who will look after the equipment once it is handed over, such as the school or the village panchayat.

Choose equipment that a small school can maintain, for example a swing set, a slide and a see-saw in galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic. Satna's summers are hot and dusty, so a shade tree or shelter helps. See our Madhya Pradesh page and nearby Rewa.

faq.q: Can you prepare documents for a CSR approval?
faq.a: Yes. We share a layout drawing, an itemised quote and our warranty terms for each site. Your CSR team can attach these to the proposal before placing the order.

faq.q: Can one CSR order cover several village schools?
faq.a: Yes. Send us details and photos for each school. We prepare a layout for every site and one combined quote, and installation can be planned school by school.

faq.q: Who maintains the equipment after installation?
faq.a: Usually the school or local body that receives it. We explain the maintenance steps at handover, and our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 helps with spare parts.

intro: Many older colonies in Secunderabad were laid out decades ago, around the cantonment and the railway quarters, and their gardens are small and already full of trees. Fitting a playground into one of these spaces takes careful planning. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for colonies, schools and societies here, at our factory in Vasai East, about 630 km away.

Secunderabad is the twin city of Hyderabad and the headquarters of the South Central Railway. We deliver by road and install through our own team or a dealer in south India. Send us the length and width of your garden, mark the trees and paths on a rough sketch and add a few photos. We will suggest equipment that fits and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Fitting a play area into a small colony garden
sections.html:
In a small garden, one compact structure usually works better than several separate pieces, because each piece needs its own clear zone. A small multi play unit such as Tiny Tot combines a slide and climbing in one footprint. Add a spring rider if space allows, since it needs little room.

Work around mature trees rather than cutting them. Their shade keeps slides cool in Telangana's hot summers. Keep the play area away from roots that lift the ground and from branches that drop. For the wider city, see our page for Hyderabad.

faq.q: Can you fit playground equipment into a very small garden?
faq.a: Usually, yes. Send us the exact measurements and photos. We will suggest compact pieces and show on a layout drawing how much clear space each one needs.

faq.q: Should we cut trees to make room for equipment?
faq.a: Not if it can be avoided. Shade helps in summer. We plan around trees where possible and only suggest moving a piece if roots or branches would make the area unsafe.

faq.q: Do you install in Secunderabad and Hyderabad?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from our Vasai factory and install through our own team or a dealer in south India, using the self-standing or grouting method that suits the ground.

intro: In Serampore, as in much of the Hooghly belt, the local para club often runs the only open ground in a neighbourhood. That same ground hosts football, morning walks and the Durga Puja pandal in autumn. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to clubs, schools and municipal parks here, made at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,640 km away.

Serampore is an old riverside town on the west bank of the Hooghly, with a Danish past and a humid climate. When a ground has many uses, the play area has to sit where it does not block the rest. Share a rough plan of the ground, with its size and the spots used for events, along with a few photos. We will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Placing play equipment on a shared club ground
sections.html:
Put the play area along one edge or in a corner, close to a boundary wall, so the centre of the ground stays free for football and the pandal. Grout the posts firmly, because crowds at festival time lean on and climb anything nearby. A low fence with a gate around the play area keeps balls and bicycles out.

Choose pieces that suit the club's budget and the children who use the ground, such as a swing set and a slide for a start. The monsoon is long and humid here, so galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic are the safer choice. See our West Bengal page.

faq.q: Can a para club order playground equipment from you?
faq.a: Yes. We work with clubs, schools, societies and public bodies. Share the ground size and photos and we will send a layout drawing and quote that the club committee can review.

faq.q: Will the equipment be in the way during Durga Puja?
faq.a: Not if it is placed well. We suggest an edge or corner of the ground so the centre stays free for the pandal, and mark this on the layout drawing.

faq.q: How is the equipment sent to Serampore?
faq.a: By road from our Vasai factory. Installation is done by our own team or a dealer in eastern India, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground.

intro: Ask a colony committee in Shahjahanpur what they want in a playground and the reply is often a slide and a swing. The more useful question is who will play there. A toddler, a six-year-old and an eleven-year-old need very different equipment. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures playground equipment for every one of these age groups at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,180 km away.

Shahjahanpur is a cantonment city in the Rohilkhand region of Uttar Pradesh, with hot summers and foggy winters. We supply schools, colonies and gardens in the city and the district, and deliver by road. Tell us the size of your site and roughly how many children of each age live nearby. We will suggest equipment for each group and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Matching equipment to the age of the children
sections.html:
• Under 5: low pieces they can use with little help, such as spring riders, toddler swings and 3 ft slides.
  • 5 to 8: small climbers, see-saws, merry-go-rounds and a compact multi play unit.
  • 8 to 12: taller slides, climbing frames and larger multi play stations that offer some challenge.

If all three groups share one site, keep the toddler pieces in a separate corner so older children running past do not knock them over. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic cope with both the summer heat and the winter damp here. Nearby buyers can also read our Delhi and Uttar Pradesh page.

faq.q: What playground equipment suits toddlers?
faq.a: Low, simple pieces such as spring riders, toddler swings and 3 ft slides. They let very young children play with little help, and a parent can stand close by.

faq.q: Can one play area serve toddlers and older children together?
faq.a: Yes, if it is zoned. Keep the toddler pieces in their own corner and place larger equipment for older children further away, with a clear walkway between them.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Shahjahanpur?
faq.a: Yes. We send the equipment by road from our Vasai factory and install it with our own team or a dealer in north India.

intro: Shillong gets rain for a large part of the year, and on its hill slopes water runs off fast and damp settles into every shaded corner. That decides most of what goes into a playground here. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, churches, localities and parks in Shillong at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 2,060 km away, and sends it by road.

Meghalaya's capital is a hill town with pine-covered slopes, cool summers and cold, dry winters. Many of its schools have a long tradition and limited flat ground. Send us the size of your space, a few photos that show the slope and the age group of the children. We will suggest equipment, mark the safe play area on a layout drawing and tell you what levelling the site needs.

sections.h: Rain, slopes and moss on a Shillong site
sections.html:
On a sloping site, cut a level platform for the play area and give it a drain on the uphill side, so runoff goes round the equipment and not through it. Grout the posts into concrete footings that sit on firm ground, not on loose fill.

In shaded, damp spots, moss and algae can grow on plastic decks and steps and make them slippery. Scrub them with water and a stiff brush every few weeks, especially during the monsoon. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic do not rot, which matters in this climate. For the region, see our Meghalaya page or nearby Guwahati.

faq.q: Can you install playground equipment on hilly ground in Shillong?
faq.a: Yes, once a level platform is ready. Our layout drawing shows the size you need. The posts are then grouted into concrete footings on firm ground.

faq.q: How do we stop plastic parts from getting slippery in the rain?
faq.a: Keep the play area well drained and scrub decks, steps and slides with water and a stiff brush every few weeks during the wet months to remove moss and algae.

faq.q: Do you deliver as far as Meghalaya?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road anywhere in India. Installation in Shillong is done by our own team or a dealer who works with us in the Northeast.

intro: Getting playground equipment to a school in Shimla is partly a road question. Many campuses and localities sit on narrow, steep lanes where a large truck cannot reach the gate. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,370 km away, and we plan the last stretch of delivery with you before dispatch.

Himachal's capital has cold winters with snow, a wet monsoon and mild summers, and schools here have a long history. We supply schools, hotels, localities and municipal gardens in and around the town. Tell us the size of your site, how close a vehicle can get and the age group of the children, and send a few photos. Our reply will include suggested pieces and a drawing of the site with each safe play area shown.

sections.h: Snow, frost and terraced ground in Shimla
sections.html:
Flat land is scarce, so most play areas go on a terrace or a levelled corner of the campus. Grouted footings need to sit below the soft top layer and stay firm through freeze and thaw. Ask your local contractor to confirm the depth for your slope.

Snow loads and frost are hard on bare metal and untreated wood. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle them well. After heavy snow, clear it off decks and slides before children play, and check that footings have not shifted once the thaw starts. Rubber flooring drains faster than soil in the monsoon. For the region, see our Uttarakhand and Himachal Pradesh page.

faq.q: Can you deliver to a site with narrow hill access?
faq.a: Yes, with some planning. Tell us how close a vehicle can get to your site and send photos of the approach. We plan packing and the last stretch of delivery with you.

faq.q: Does playground equipment survive snow?
faq.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic cope with snow and frost. Clear snow off the equipment before use and check bolts and footings after the winter.

faq.q: Do you supply hotels in Shimla?
faq.a: Yes. We supply hotels, resorts, schools and public gardens. Share your site details and the age group of guests' children and we will suggest a layout.

intro: Shimoga stands at the edge of the Malnad region of Karnataka, where the western ghats bring a long and heavy monsoon. The ground under a playground stays wet for months, so the choice of surface matters as much as the equipment. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to schools, societies and parks in Shimoga, made at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 670 km away.

The city sits on the Tunga river and is the gateway to Jog Falls and the Malnad hill towns. Rain is heavier towards the ghats and lighter on the eastern side of the district. Share the size of your site, the age group and a few photos taken in the rainy season if you have them. We will suggest equipment and a surface, and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Choosing the surface under the equipment
sections.html:
Grass looks good in a dry month, but under swings and slides it wears to mud within weeks of the monsoon starting. Sand cushions falls when dry, but it packs hard when wet, washes away in heavy rain and needs regular topping up. Bare concrete or stone is unsafe under any play equipment.

Rubber flooring on a compacted, drained base handles Shimoga's rain best. Water runs off quickly, the surface stays usable soon after a shower and falls are cushioned. We supply rubber flooring along with the equipment. Give the base a slight slope towards a drain. For nearby towns, see our pages for Davanagere and Udupi.

faq.q: Is grass a good surface under playground equipment?
faq.a: Not in a wet area. Grass under swings and slides wears away quickly and turns to mud in the monsoon. Rubber flooring on a drained base lasts longer and cushions falls.

faq.q: Do you supply rubber flooring?
faq.a: Yes. We supply rubber flooring for play areas along with our equipment. Tell us the size of the area and we will include it in the layout and quote.

faq.q: Do you install in Shimoga district?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from our Vasai factory and install through our own team or a dealer in south India, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground.

intro: Shivpuri was the summer capital of the Scindias, and today families come for its lakes and the Madhav National Park. A garden or picnic spot here draws grandparents, parents and children of every age on the same afternoon. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for gardens, hotels, schools and colonies in Shivpuri at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 830 km away.

When a whole family visits together, a playground that only suits one age group leaves the others waiting. We plan public gardens with pieces for small children, older children and adults, and seating close by. Send us the size of your garden, its main paths and a few photos. We will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing that shows the safe play area around each piece.

sections.h: A family garden with something for every age
sections.html:
Start with pieces that let an adult and a child play together. A mother and child swing lets a parent sit with a toddler, and a see-saw or merry-go-round keeps siblings busy together. For older children, add a slide tower or climber a little further away.

Put benches or a gazebo just outside the safe play area so elders can sit in the shade and watch. Shivpuri's summers are hot and dry, and the monsoon arrives around late June. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle both. For nearby cities, see our Gwalior page.

faq.q: Do you have play equipment that parents can use with small children?
faq.a: Yes. Our mother and child swing has a seat for an adult and one for a toddler. See-saws and merry-go-rounds also work well for parents and children playing together.

faq.q: Can you supply garden benches and gazebos too?
faq.a: Yes. Our garden decor range includes benches, gazebos and pergolas. We can add them to the same layout drawing as the play equipment.

faq.q: How does the equipment reach Shivpuri?
faq.a: We send it by road from our Vasai factory. Our installation team or a local dealer installs it, grouted or self-standing depending on your ground.

intro: In Sikar, the wind carries fine sand for much of the dry season, and it settles in every joint, bearing and slide bed on an open play area. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, coaching campuses, colonies and gardens in Sikar at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 940 km away, and sends it by road.

The city is part of the Shekhawati region of Rajasthan, known for its painted havelis and, in recent years, for its many schools and coaching institutes. Summers are very hot and winter nights are cold. Send us the size of your site, the age group and a few photos. We will suggest equipment that copes with sand and heat and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Keeping sand out of the moving parts
sections.html:
Sand is hardest on parts that move. Swing hooks, spring riders, merry-go-round bearings and see-saw pivots wear faster when grit gets in. Sweep or blow sand off the equipment every week in the dry months, and wipe the moving parts clean before the summer holidays end.

Fixed pieces such as climbers and slides need less attention, so they suit a school with limited maintenance staff. A boundary wall, hedge or row of trees on the windward side cuts down the sand that reaches the play area. Shade over slides helps in May and June. See our Rajasthan page or nearby Jaipur.

faq.q: How do we look after playground equipment in a sandy area?
faq.a: Sweep sand off every week in the dry season, keep moving parts such as hooks, springs and bearings clean, and check them more often than you would in a less dusty town.

faq.q: Which equipment needs the least maintenance?
faq.a: Fixed pieces without moving parts, such as climbers and slides. Swings, spring riders and merry-go-rounds are popular but need more regular checks.

faq.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Sikar?
faq.a: Yes. We send it by road from our Vasai factory and install it through our own team or a dealer in north India.

intro: Silchar is about 2,140 km from our factory in Vasai East, and most buyers here will never see our equipment before it arrives. So the planning has to be done well on paper, using your photos and measurements. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, societies and parks in Silchar and the Barak valley, and sends it by road.

Silchar, on the Barak river in southern Assam, is humid and gets a long, heavy monsoon. Good photos and accurate measurements let us plan your site as if we had visited it. Share them along with the age group of the children, and we will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. You approve the layout and quote before we start manufacturing.

sections.h: Photos to send when we cannot visit your site
sections.html:
• One wide photo from each corner of the space, so we can see its full shape.
  • Close photos of the ground surface, any slope, drains and places where water collects.
  • Photos of trees, poles, walls and overhead wires near the area, and of the gate a delivery vehicle will use.

Add the length and width in feet or metres, and mark north on a rough sketch. With this, our layout drawing shows where each piece sits and how much safe play area it needs. For Silchar's wet climate, plan rubber flooring on a raised base. See our Assam page.

faq.q: Can you plan our playground without visiting the site?
faq.a: Yes. Most of our layouts are planned from the buyer's photos and measurements. Send wide photos, close-ups of the ground and the length and width of the space.

faq.q: Do you deliver to the Barak valley?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road anywhere in India, including Silchar and the surrounding districts. Installation is done by our own team or a dealer who works with us in the Northeast.

faq.q: What happens if something is damaged on arrival?
faq.a: Check the equipment when it is unloaded and photograph any damage. Then contact our after-sales team at aftersales@funplaysystems.com or +91 738 530 0921.
